title: Power Apps: consolidated AI settings for model-driven apps in Maker Studio and Copilot hub
summary: Hold for corrections to the form-fill Default behaviour, the automation guidance and the claim that metering for all governed skills is unpublished. The main Copilot settings paths and roadmap details are supported, but the briefing also overstates the restrictions on unmanaged environments.

claims.claim: POST SaveSettingValue with AppUniqueName, SettingName and Value is a complete REST call for an app-level override.
claims.quote: Searched: "SaveSettingValue" "POST". Read SaveSettingValue Action and Use Web API actions. The action and three parameters exist, but the printed call omits the Dataverse service path and API version; the action reference supplies no standalone relative POST example.
claims.fix: Replace the call with POST <organization URI>/api/data/v9.2/SaveSettingValue {"AppUniqueName":"<app unique name>","SettingName":"<setting definition unique name>","Value":"<value>"}. Retain the action reference and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/use-web-api-actions for the POST and versioned service-root syntax. The pre-check's missing literal POST does not mean the action is fictitious.

claims.claim: Whether any governed skill draws on a meter is Not yet published.
claims.quote:
In Power Apps and Power Automate, prompt and model capabilities consume Copilot Credits in the following scenarios:
- When there are no AI Builder credits available.
- When AI Builder credits computed consumption is in overage compared to initial capacity.
claims.fix: Replace 'Whether any of them draws on a meter is Not yet published' with 'Microsoft says row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts. AI Builder prompt and model capabilities in Power Apps consume Copilot Credits when AI Builder credits are unavailable or exceeded.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/common/faq-record-summaries and https://learn.microsoft.com/ai-builder/message-management. Do not infer a feature-specific rate or change the consolidation's cost rating.
